items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ, ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ, ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ, نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ, مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ, عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ, أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ, سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ, أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ, أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ, أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ, أَنْ تَجْعَلَ القُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي, وَنُورَ صَدْرِي, وَجَلاَءَ حُزْنِي, وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
items.reference: Ahmad 1/391, and Al-Albani graded it authentic.
items.title: For anxiety and sorrow
items.translation: O Allah, I am Your slave and the son of Your male slave and the son of your female slave. My forehead is in Your Hand (i.e. You have control over me). Your Judgment upon me is assured and Your Decree concerning me is just. I ask You by every Name that You have named Yourself with, revealed in Your Book, taught any one of Your creation or kept unto Yourself in the knowledge of the unseen that is with You, to make the Qur'an the spring of my heart, and the light of my chest, the banisher of my sadness and the reliever of my distress.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ, وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ, وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ, وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
items.title: For anxiety and sorrow
items.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in you from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men.

items.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ, لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ, لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
items.title: For one in distress
items.translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو, فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ, وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ, لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
items.title: For one in distress
items.translation: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy. Do not leave me to myself even for the blinking of an eye. Correct all of my affairs for me. There is none worthy of worship but You.

items.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظّالِمِينَ
items.title: For one in distress
items.translation: There is none worthy of worship but You, glory is to You. Surely, I was among the wrong doers.

items.arabic: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً
items.title: For one in distress
items.translation: Allah, Allah is my Lord. I do not associate anything with Him.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِم, وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
items.title: Upon encountering an enemy or those of authority
items.translation: O Allah, we ask You to restrain them by their necks and we seek refuge in You from their evil.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي, وَأَنْتَ نَصِيرِي, بِكَ أَحُولُ وَبِكَ أَصُولُ, وَبِكَ أُقاتِلُ
items.title: Upon encountering an enemy or those of authority
items.translation: O Allah, You are my strength and You are my support. For Your sake I go forth and for Your sake I advance and for Your sake I fight.

items.arabic: حَسْبُنا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
items.title: Upon encountering an enemy or those of authority
items.translation: Allah is sufficient for us and the best of those on whom to depend.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ربَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ, وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ, كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ, وَأَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلاَئِقِكَ, أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ يَطْغَى, عَزَّ جَارُكَ, وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ, وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
items.title: Invocation against the oppression of rulers
items.translation: O Allah, Lord of the Seven heavens, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, be for me a support against (say the person's name) and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is Your patronage and glorious are Your praises. There is none worthy of worship but You.

items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ, اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ جَمِيعاً, اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَأَحْذَرُ, أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ, الْمُمْسِكِ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ أَنْ يَقَعْنَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ, مِنْ شَرِّ عَبْدِكَ فُلاَنٍ, وَجُنُودِهِ وَأَتْبَاعِهِ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ, مِنْ الْجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ, اللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ شَرِّهِمْ, جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَعَزَّ جَارُكَ, وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ, وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
items.title: Invocation against the oppression of rulers
items.translation: Allah is the Most Great, Mightier than all His creation. He is Mightier than what I fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, Who there is none worthy of worship but Him. He is the One Who holds the Seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His command. (I seek refuge in You Allah) from the evil of Your slave (say the person's name), and his helpers, his followers and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my support against their evil. Glorious are Your praises and mighty is Your patronage. Blessed is Your Name, there is no true God but You. (Three times)

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ, سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ, اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ, اللَّهُمَّ اهزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
items.title: Against enemies
items.translation: Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift to account, defeat the groups (of disbelievers). O Allah, defeat them and shake them.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ
items.title: When being afraid of a group of people
items.translation: O Allah, suffice me against them however You wish.

items.arabic: يَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ, يَنْتَهِي عَمَّا وَسْوَسَ فِيهِ
items.title: For one afflicted with doubt in his faith
items.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from satan the outcast (then you should desist from doing what you are in doubt about).

items.arabic: يَقُولُ: آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
items.title: For one afflicted with doubt in his faith
items.translation: I believe in Allah and His Messenger.

items.arabic: يَقْرَأُ قَوْلَهُ تَعَالَى: ﴿هُوَ الْأوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظّاهِرُ وَالْباطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾
items.title: For one afflicted with doubt in his faith
items.translation: He is the First and the Last, the Most High and the Most Near. And He is the Knower of all things

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ, وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكِ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
items.title: Settling a debt
items.translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have allowed instead of what You have forbidden, and make me independent of all others besides You.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ, وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ, وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ, وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
items.title: Settling a debt
items.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and from being overpowered by men

items.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ, اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي, وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرَاً مِنْهَا
items.title: For one afflicted by a calamity
items.translation: We are from Allah and unto Him we return. O Allah take me out of my plight and bring to me after it something better.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ, وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لاَ أَعْلَمُ
items.title: For fear of shirk
items.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I associate anything with You knowingly, and I seek Your forgiveness for what I know not.

items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ طَيْرَ إِلاَّ طَيْرُكَ, وَلاَ خَيْرَ إِلاَّ خَيْرُكَ, وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
items.title: Forbiddance of ascribing things to omens
items.translation: O Allah there is no portent other than Your portent, no goodness other than Your goodness, and none worthy of worship other than You.

items.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَسُرُّهُ قَالَ: (الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ) وَإِذَا أَتَاهُ الْأَمْرُ يَكْرَهُهُ قَالَ: (الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ)
items.title: What to say upon receiving pleasing or displeasing news
items.translation: When something happened that pleased him say: "Praise is to Allah Who by His blessings all good things are perfected".(1)And if something happened that displeased him say: "Praise is to Allah in all circumstances".(2)

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ!
items.title: At times of amazement and delight
items.translation: Glory is to Allah.

items.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ!
items.title: At times of amazement and delight
items.translation: Allah is the Most Great.

items.arabic: كَانَ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ أَمْرٌ يَسُرُّهُ أَوْ يُسَرُّ بِهِ خَرَّ سَاجِداً شُكْراً لِلَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى
items.title: Upon receiving pleasant news
items.translation: Whenever something happened that pleased him or made him happy, the Prophet would prostrate himself in gratitude to Allah, the Blessed, the All-Mighty.

items.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ!
items.title: When startled
items.translation: There is none worthy of worship but Allah.
